plugins.name: lexi
plugins.description: Test-first flow without the spec ceremony. A PreToolUse hook keeps source edits behind a mirror test and protects existing assertions; /lexi:lexi drives one vertical slice at a time, red to green. Includes the Jev layer (model and effort router, verbatim compaction, /lexi:code-review) and the interface (usage row with the routed model, gate result, subagent pane). Jev stays off in a project until /lexi:init turns it on; the interface needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. Requires ponytail and caveman. Run /lexi:init once per project.
